purpose: test a residence-aware E-K attempt and protected R-JF fallback policy on the combined difficult and expanded generic corpora without active commit switching
required_inputs: G4-S1 quadratic, oscillatory-PR, blend and advection-diffusion accepted-step telemetry
actual E-K prefix and full-step timings
candidate_policies: R-JF-default with event-triggered E-K trial and reusable prefix
E-K-first transactional trial with immediate R-JF fallback and cooldown

state_machine_constraints.proper_homotopy: deferred unless both E-K and R-JF fail

kill_rule: If neither asymmetric policy beats static protected R-JF after full trial/fallback cost, stop switching research and retain R-JF as static default.
